summary: More uri examples: reusing a login cookie, triggering a Jenkins build, POSTing a local or remote file, calling an Azure API with custom headers, polling a URL until it returns 200, and specifying TLS ciphers as a list or string.
questions: How do I wait until a URL becomes reachable?
How do I reuse cookies from a previous uri login?
How do I trigger a Jenkins job via uri?
How do I POST a file stored on the remote host?
How do I set TLS ciphers for uri?

answer_card.title: uri examples (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: https://your.form.based.auth.example.com/dashboard.php
    headers:
      Cookie: "{{ login.cookies_string }}"
- ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: https://httpbin.org/post
    method: POST
    src: /path/to/my/file.json
    remote_src: true
- ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://192.0.2.1/some/test"
    follow_redirects: none
  register: _result
  until: _result.status == 200
  retries: 720
  delay: 5
- uri:
    url: https://example.org
    ciphers: ['@SECLEVEL=2', ECDH+AESGCM, '!aNULL']
```
